description: The route graph of plain screens: deeplink -> endpoint

deeplink.description: Matches the string a server puts into navigate.deeplink

endpoint.description: The relative address the screen is fetched from. Its endpoint kind MUST equal this route's kind

kind.description: What stands behind the endpoint, in the vocabulary of x-kompot-endpoint-kind: "screen" yields a KompotComponent, "form" a KompotFormResponse. Absent means "screen". An open string rather than an enum on purpose: a client MUST ignore a route whose kind it does not recognise, and an unknown enum constant would fail the parse of the whole graph before one route could be skipped
